visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a short dark bob haircut, wearing a cream-colored polka-dot shirt with black overalls, smiles warmly at the camera in a modern kitchen setting with dark wood cabinets. She holds a large, translucent green plastic bag filled with shopping items toward the lens. The scene then cuts to her inside a bright SUGI Pharmacy, wearing a sheer blue floral overlay, walking past shelves of bottled beverages and medicine. Finally, a man in a dark shirt and a child in a stroller are shown in a minimalist hotel lobby with large windows overlooking a bright courtyard. (2) The visual focus shifts to a detailed product showcase where the woman demonstrates several items. She applies white cream from an Elixir tube to her cheek, blending it with her hand. Close-ups show her holding a yellow vitamin capsule, a tube of toothpaste with a white toothbrush, and three distinct pouches of S SELECT sunscreen in pink, blue, and green. The lighting is bright and consistent, emphasizing the product labels and textures. She displays various bags of colorful nutritional gummies designed for children, using expressive facial cues to signal approval. (3) The demonstration continues with household items, showing a hand using a blue applicator to place a flower-shaped cleaning gel inside a white toilet bowl. This is followed by shots of the woman’s smartphone displaying the official SUGI Pharmacy Instagram page and various digital discount coupons with percentages like 4% and 8%. The video ends with her standing outside a pharmacy with a prominent red sign, walking through a traditional Japanese street with her child, and a final close-up selfie of the two smiling at the camera.
